what: The proposed review-and-fix env-key auth-prep failure case is not reachable with the stated “same mv/config rewrite” mechanism. In env-key mode, external_prepare_codex_auth ignores strip failures with `|| true` and returns 0 after preparing the temp CODEX_HOME.
